name: Aldo Dixon
life: “I still remember walking away from a salon with glitter still under my nails.” Sunday often includes a stop at the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio, where Aldo notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I quit my last salon over this and swore the next owner would hear my reasons before getting my notice.
appearance: After the last appointment, look for a moss-green cardigan and a square of clean cloth for polishing smudges. Aldo has a broad nose and a deep dimple on one cheek, with short black hair swept back. Aldo folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing during a conversation.
personality: Aldo enjoys bargaining, including over things already settled. It is partly a joke and partly a test of whether the other person feels able to say no.
agenda: To get an answer from this owner before resigning.
family: Terry Lin is Aldo’s stepsibling. Aldo chooses whether they walk home or sit a while. Terry brings a spare shopping bag. That small arrangement gives both a reason to see each other on weeks when asking for company outright feels difficult. Asked about *Money after marriage*, Terry says, “I used to get invited to both houses. Once I put a price on the company neither was sure I could still come to dinner.”
connections: Tali Harris (salon owner). The worker who would quit explains the exact terms the owner once protested herself.

reactions.situation: An apprentice asks if declining will cost future shifts
reactions.response: Aldo asks the owner to give the apprentice a direct answer in front of a witness of their choosing.
